name: Day · {date}
no_text: Nothing of this day was transcribed yet, so there is no recap to write.
transcript_expired: This recording’s transcript has expired; only its recap is kept, so it can’t be written again.
stale: The recap changed. Reload it and try again.
unknown_action: This recap has no suggested to-do {id}.
no_recap: This recording has no recap yet.
todo_notes: From the day recap of {day}, said at {clock}.
not_day: This recording isn’t an all-day recording.
base_changed: This recording was uploaded again since that base. Continue from the latest upload.
segments_gap: Sentences are missing before these. Send again from {next}.
day_full: This part of the day is full. Continue in the next part.
kind_changed: A recording becomes an all-day recording only at its first upload, and stays one.
